bagPolicy.summary: All bags entering Simmons Bank Arena will be inspected, and bags larger than 14" x 14" x 6" are not allowed. Backpacks, large bags, suitcases, and luggage are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available around Simmons Bank Arena, with access from Washington Avenue. Visitors should follow directional signs for the best parking options. Pricing details are not specified on the website.

rideshare.note: Use the southwest side of the arena at Washington Street and Simmons Bank Arena Street for pickup and drop-off. Vehicles cannot park in this area.

concessions.note: Alcoholic beverages can be purchased inside the arena, with a limit of two drinks per person at a time. No outside food or beverages are allowed.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Seats are held throughout the arena for wheelchair users, guests with visual or hearing impairments, and guests with limited mobility. Accessible drop-off is at the lower box office entrance on Washington Ave. Service animals are welcome on a leash or harness; mention it when you buy so an aisle seat can be reserved.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed at Simmons Bank Arena for any event.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets left at will call (radio winners, artist guests, etc) are typically available 60-90 minutes before showtime and can be picked up with photo ID at the box office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrances include the Simmons Bank Arena Drive Entrance (Lobby), the Broadway St. Entrance (Section 121), and the Washington St. Entrance (Section 106).
